notes.title: Update #6: Happy New Year
Release Hitler is My Crush: Love and Fascism
notes.notes:
Hey, hi. Today the sequel to my game Hitler is My Crush was released. I tried to take into account the past mistakes and I want to say right away that there will be a lot of updates and content before the full release.

Please report all the mistakes and feedback, I really need it. Thank you.


Don't forget for mine [url=https://x.com/darklightstudi2]Twitter(X)[/url] :)

notes.title: Update #5: Hitler is in your inventory!
notes.notes:
Hello, quite unexpectedly the idea came to mind to sort something out, and that’s how it turned out. Meet your [b]Crush Hitler[/b], in your inventory. All you need to do is go into the game and find a place where you can get it and it will be in your [b]STEAM INVENTORY[/b]

Fixed a minor bug and added the item to your Steam inventory, you just need to find it in the game.
[b]And it is also sold on the marketplace![/b]

[*] Changed the position of some enemies (Enemies are also walking -_-)
[*] Added mini-boss (with cringe and gag)
[*] Added some objects to the map (It's about time)
[*] Now it’s possible to get out of the trench (all for you)
[*] Quest text moved
[*] Perhaps I optimized the game a little or made it worse, who knows

[/list]

notes.title: Update #1: Oh, what is this?
notes.notes:
After a bottle of beer in honor of the game's release, it's time to download the update, let's go!!!

[b]And what do we have here?:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the balance of enemies and boss (it was too easy)
[*] The position of some enemies has been changed (otherwise they were hiding from you, wow)
[*] The map has been slightly changed (you won’t notice, but it’s pleasing to my eyes)
[*] Added some effects to the map (WOW effects)
[*] Added a new pistol (It has more ammo, more damage and is just so beautiful)
[/list]


[u]Be sure to leave your feedback on the game so that I know whether you liked it or not and what needs to be changed. Thank you.[/u]
